propositions: Bare-repository fixture setup commands fail with exit 128 under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit repository discovery (cwd or git -C) instead of explicit --git-dir targeting.

Commands intentionally operating on bare test repositories must explicitly identify the repository with --git-dir rather than relying on cwd or -C, because Git 2.55+ rejects implicit bare discovery under protected safe.bareRepository=explicit.

Generic Git subprocess helpers that serve both worktrees and bare repositories cannot be blanket-converted; worktree invocations must retain -C behavior while bare-specific call sites require explicit --git-dir targeting.
Fixture portability requires supported tests to pass both locally under strict Git configuration and in CI under default Git configuration, without mutating host/global/system Git safety settings.
